description:
Take the welcome tour and discover how this system is much more than meets the eye! Walk around a virtual exhibition shaped like a giant Nintendo Switch™ 2 system and look, touch, and feel your way through the exhibits. Each area is designed to teach you about the technology that went into building the hardware, such as the sensors used for mouse controls and the mechanism that powers the HD rumble 2 feature.

Learn about basic features, like the magnetic connectors that keep the Joy-Con™ 2 controllers firmly attached, and about more advanced tech details that you might not otherwise notice. Uncover hidden facts, enjoy playful minigames and tech demos, and test your knowledge with quizzes as you explore the exhibit halls!
name: Nintendo Switch™ 2 Welcome Tour
intro: Get an inside look at the Nintendo Switch™ 2 system
